title: STRIPE RELAXED POLO
description: Pastel blue and green striped organic cotton knitted polo. Relaxed boxy fit with cropped sleeves and contrast navy blue collar. Concealed button closure, vents in the sides.

title: CUTWORK APPLIQUÉ PANT SET
description: White shirt in all-over hand sewn cutwork appliqué. Shirt collar with a button-down front. Full sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Straight fit. Paired with complementary black straight cut pant in all-over hand-sewn cutwork reverse appliqué. Concealed zip and button closure with belt loops at the waist. Pockets in the sides. Garment is fully lined. Lightweight fabric with intricate placement for a textural finish. As these are manually cut and embroidered, slight variations in the cutwork patterns may occur from piece to piece, making each set unique.

title: CHIKAN-STITCH SHIRT
description: Ivory chikan-stitch shirt with gold-toned rivet detailing. Shirt collar with a front button-down placket and marble-gold inlay buttons. Full sleeves with buttoned cuffs.

title: INVERTED PLEAT PANT
description: Black cotton satin pant in a straight fit with an exaggerated pleat sewn in the front. Belt loops with hook/eye and zip closure. Pockets in the sides. Welt pocket at the back. Relaxed fit.

title: PLEATED SHORTS
description: Printed pleated shorts in a hand painted black and white check. Fully elasticated waistband with a zip fly and hook closure. Side pockets.

title: PRINTED LINEN SET
description: White linen full sleeve button-down shirt. Placement abstract watercolour print on the shoulder. Concealed button placket. Regular fit. Paired with matching relaxed fit white linen pants with a placed abstract watercolour print. Fully elasticated waistband and functional side pockets.

title: LINEN EMBROIDERED PANT SET
description: Full sleeve shirt in soft beige earthy linen. Dramatic large ivory and black embroidered motif placed in the back, with smaller motifs on the shirt collar and full sleeves. Concealed button-down placket. Garment is fully lined. Paired with matching straight cut pant with dramatic ivory and black embroidered motifs placed at the knee. Concealed side zip with hook/eye closure. Pockets in the sides.
composition: Fabric:Shirt: 70% Viscose 30% Linen, Pant: 90% Cotton 10% Linen

title: PINTUCK LONGLINE SHIRT AND CRUSHED CRINKLED PANT
description: Relaxed fit shirt in cocoa organic viscose with hand-applied pintuck detailing on the front. Band collar with a self-fabric button-down placket. Curved hem with vents in the sides. Full sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Paired with matching hand-crushed textured pant with a crinkled finish. Semi elasticated waistband with zip and hook/eye closure. Elasticated cuffs for shape.

title: MUGHAL PRINT SHIRT
description: Relaxed fit shirt in a vivid Mughal-inspired floral panel print. Architectural arch motifs all over.  Band collar with front button-down and concealed button placket. Straight fit with full sleeves in an all-over print.

title: LINEN SHORTS
description: Green linen shorts. Elasticated waistband, front zip and hook closure. Includes side pockets and back patch pockets.

title: EMBROIDERED IKAT PRINT SET
description: Relaxed fit shirt in organic viscose twill with heritage-inspired ikat-style motifs in a geometric layout. Metallic gold thread embroidery placed on the band collar and front placket. Concealed button-down placket with buttoned cuffs. Full sleeves. Paired with matching relaxed fit pant. Belt loops at the waist with concealed zip and hook/eye closure. Pockets in the sides.

title: CUTWORK APPLIQUÉ POPOVER SHIRT
description: Tonal blue popover shirt in all-over hand sewn cutwork appliqué. Band collar concealed button placket. Full sleeves with broad cuffs. Straight fit. As these are manually cut and embroidered, slight variations in the cutwork patterns may occur from piece to piece, making each shirt unique.M/1073

title: TEXTURED PANT SET
description: Relaxed fit black shirt in organic cotton mull with textural detailing. Strategically placed pintucks with hand-cut reverse pleats create vertical stripework, while raw edges form a subtle chevron pattern. Full sleeves with a concealed snap-button placket and a classic shirt collar. Paired with matching relaxed fit pant. Zip fly with hook/eye closure. Pockets in the sides and patch pockets at the back.

title: ZARDOZI PRINTED SHIRT
description: Straight fit shirt in a slate blue base patterned with lattice florals, pineapple emblems, and feline motifs. Zardozi embroidered band collar with hand-done gold dori work. Concealed button down placket. Full sleeves.

title: LINEN EMBROIDERED PANT SET WITH SHAWL
description: Full sleeve shirt in soft beige earthy linen. Dramatic large ivory and black embroidered motif placed in the back, with smaller motifs on the shirt collar and full sleeves. Concealed button-down placket. Garment is fully lined. Paired with matching straight cut pant with dramatic ivory and black embroidered motifs placed at the knee. Concealed side zip with hook/eye closure. Pockets in the sides. Worn with matching shawl with ivory and black embroidered edge borders. A dramatic large motif is placed at the center. Versatile styling - the shawl can be draped in multiple ways, worn as an attached drape or as a separate piece.
composition: Fabric:Shirt/Shawl: 70% Viscose 30% Linen, Pant: 90% Cotton 10% Linen

title: PAISLEY EMBROIDERED PANT SET
description: Black popover shirt with placed paisley embroidery on the front in tonal shades of blue. V-neckline with hand-sewn embroidery along the edges. Full sleeves with smaller paisley motifs embroidered on the cuffs. Relaxed fit. Paired with straight fit pant in tonal black with contrast paisley embroidery placed front and back above the knees. Relaxed fit. Concealed zip and button closure with belt loops at the waist. Made in all weather suiting material.

title: MOTIF EMBROIDERED LINEN SHIRT
description: Relaxed fit linen shirt in tonal black with scattered multicolour floral thread embroidery. Shawl collar with a front button-down placket. Full sleeves with buttoned cuffs.

title: MUGHAL PRINT PANT SET
description: Relaxed fit shirt in a vivid Mughal-inspired floral panel print. Architectural arch motifs all over.  Band collar with front button-down and concealed button placket. description: Ikat motif popover shirt in cotton. Contrast navy sleeve cuffs, front placket, and collar. Running hand applied kantha stitching on the full sleeve cuffs, collar, and front placket. Vents in the sides. Relaxed fit.

title: SCARF SHIRT
description: Scarf shirt in slate olive organic viscose satin. High round neck with back button loop closure. Draped scarf panel attached at one shoulder, styled to be worn in multiple ways. Full sleeves. Relaxed fit.

Zip fly with hook/eye closure. Straight fit. Pockets in the sides.

title: TEXTURED BLACK SHIRT
description: Relaxed fit black shirt in organic cotton mull with textural detailing. Strategically placed pintucks with hand-cut reverse pleats create vertical stripework, while raw edges form a subtle chevron pattern. Full sleeves with a concealed snap-button placket and a classic shirt collar.

description: Band collar placement bandhani shirt with a concealed button down placket. Relaxed fit with full sleeves and snap button cuffs. Each piece is unique as the bandhani tie & dye is a hand-done process.

title: TEXTURED JACQUARD SHIRT

description: Landscape print beige shirt in cotton poplin. Both panels of the front of the shirt feature different prints that complement one another. Solid beige shirt collar, placket, half sleeves and back. Front button down.
